name: Stonetalon Standstill
label: Quest
description: Stonetalon Standstill is a Horde assignment given by Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post to secure the vital passage toward the Stonetalon Mountains.…
intro: Stonetalon Standstill is a Horde assignment given by Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post to secure the vital passage toward the Stonetalon Mountains. Befouled water elementals in Mystral Lake have brought supply transports to a halt, prompting the Horde to cull the hostile spirits and scout an elven gazebo overlooking nearby Alliance movements.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?

The transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... Which means anyone on the path. What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You back already? What's the situation out there - all cleared up now, thanks to you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens. From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends. Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...
Looks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it. Take this - you've earned it.
